model: RDS120.B Smart Thermostat (BACnet version of RDS120)
applies_to: Siemens RDS120.B smart thermostats (the BACnet version of the RDS120) for fan coils, heat pumps, rooftop and similar HVAC applications.
summary: The RDS120.B is a touchscreen room thermostat whose BACnet object table covers every application it can run: fan coil, heat pump, DX, electric and gas heat, humidity and outside-air damper control. Many objects exist once per input or output variant, and nearly every temperature object has a °F twin at instance + 256 named with _US.
notes: Object table from section 8.5 "BACnet objects (RDS120.B only)" of the commissioning manual, 380 rows; the identifier column gives type,instance.
Names are the "Obj. Name Base" column with wrap spaces removed; the full name adds a room prefix (%R%'...).
Several objects share a name but differ by instance, one per input signal type or application output (e.g. TR(1) for Ni1000, 0-10 V, NTC and Pt1000 inputs).
There is no access column: objects with a Default Command value (setpoints, enables, BOs, mode MVs) are marked C, the rest R.
Printed oddities kept: TR(2)_US at AI 270 is printed as TR(1)_US; some _US rows repeat the 10V names for the 0V references.
The manual does not state the BACnet transport or network settings.

integration.summary: Command the room operating mode with MV 75 ROpMod and set the Comfort heating and cooling setpoints (AV 176 / AV 191, or the _US twins). Read the present mode and setpoints, the room temperature and the heating/cooling state back. Map only the objects for the application and inputs actually configured.

minimum_points.name: ROpMod
minimum_points.why: Room operating mode command: 1 = Protection ... 4 = Comfort

setup: Pick °C or °F objects and stay consistent; the _US objects sit at instance + 256.
gotchas: Objects for unused inputs or applications are still in the table; map only what the thermostat is configured for.
Several names repeat with different instances; always map by instance, not by name.
